description: This file defines and exports functions related to theming and color palettes for a data management dashboard. It includes a theme object for the Ocean Professional style and functions to generate categorical color palettes and category-to-color mappings.

methods.name: getOceanTheme()
methods.description: Returns an object containing theme tokens such as colors, typography, radius, and elevation settings for the Ocean Professional theme.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette(count)
methods.description: Generates a deterministic array of color strings for categorical series, seeded by Ocean colors, extended to meet the requested count.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap(categories)
methods.description: Creates a mapping from category names to colors using the categorical palette, preserving input order and ensuring consistent assignment.
